notes.title: 10,000 Wishlists Achieved!
notes.content:
[h2]🐷 10,000 Wishlists Achieved! 👑[/h2][p]We’ve finally reached our goal of 10,000 wishlists!! 🎊
Huge thanks to everyone who supported us and played the demo!! ✨
We're truly surprised by the rapid growth and all the positive feedback.
We’ll keep working hard to make KimiMuzi a game that reaches even more people! 🔥[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578462/2c3b62d8dfcd8165486499cb475a30b2cbd00645.png"][/img][/p]
